summary: Scores the labelled recall eval and writes work/results.md as two plain-English tables: (1) finding — top-1/3/5 of the prompts that needed a note, prompt-only vs prompt+last-3-exchanges, with a paired sign test vs BM25; (2) gating — per system and gate signal, 'tells apart' (AUC worded as a pair comparison), whether history's gain beats a 2000-sample bootstrap, the fixed-rule score and a 2-fold even/odd fitted-cutoff score, against the 'never show a note' baseline. Every row ranks with the system's own PROMPT-only top 3; only the gate's input changes, because on the coldstart v2 set history helped ranking yet the gates were the open question. Refuses to run until every item in items.json has a label. `--clean` deletes everything in WORK except results.md plus the local model-cache/ (USER: only final results are kept on the measured machine). On the frozen coldstart v2 set it reproduces the original numbers exactly (gemma2 top-3 60→68/108, never-show 192, best gate 201).
